title: Input schema of the BeReal Public Discovery Scraper

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Discovery feed or explore pages to start scraping (public pages only).

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages the crawler will open per run.

scrollIterations.title: Scroll iterations
scrollIterations.description: How many times to scroll the feed to load additional posts.

authMethod.title: Authentication method
authMethod.description: Set to 'cookie' to provide a session cookie, 'credentials' for login placeholders, or 'none' for unauthenticated scraping (may be limited).

cookieString.title: Cookie string
cookieString.description: If authMethod is 'cookie', paste your session cookie here (store secrets in env vars on Cloud).

downloadImages.title: Download images
downloadImages.description: When true, the Actor downloads images to the Key-Value store under images/<postId>.*

dedupe.title: Deduplicate posts
dedupe.description: If true, seen post IDs are stored in Key-Value store and only new posts are output.
